197                       // credits the sender consumed for this TLP, from what was actually received

212                       // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
213                       // credit accounting
214                       // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
215                       function automatic logic [7:0]  ADV_H(input int c);
216        1/1              return (c == 0) ? 8'(P_HDR_CR)  : (c == 1) ? 8'(NP_HDR_CR)  : 8'(CPL_HDR_CR);

219        1/1              return (c == 0) ? 12'(P_DATA_CR) : (c == 1) ? 12'(NP_DATA_CR) : 12'(CPL_DATA_CR);

236                       // release events (hdr, data) per class this cycle
237                       logic [7:0]  rel_h [0:2];

273                       end
274                       assign {fc_rel_pulse_cpl, fc_rel_pulse_np, fc_rel_pulse_p} = pulse;

                        MISSING_ELSE

                        MISSING_ELSE
125                         end
126                       end
127                     
128                       // ---- AXI side FSM -----------------------------------------------------------------
129                       typedef enum logic [1:0] {M_IDLE, M_AW, M_W} m_st_t;
130                       m_st_t m_st;
131                       logic [27:0] c_o; logic [3:0] c_fb, c_lb; logic [9:0] c_l; logic [6:0] c_nw; logic [15:0] c_start;
132                       logic [6:0]  iss_left;      // beats still to be read from RAM
133                       logic [PAW-1:0] iss_addr;
134                       logic        wv;            // W beat held in RAM output register
135                       logic [6:0]  w_idx;         // index of the beat in the RAM output register
136                       logic [6:0]  iss_idx;
137                       logic [6:0]  last_idx;
138                       logic [15:0] pend_ok;
139                     
140                       wire head_resolved = (d_rp != d_res);
141                       wire [15:0] words_have = wcnt - d_start[d_rp[RDW-1:0]];
142                       wire head_ready = head_resolved && d_ok[d_rp[RDW-1:0]] && (words_have >= {9'b0, d_nw[d_rp[RDW-1:0]]});
143                       wire head_skip  = head_resolved && !d_ok[d_rp[RDW-1:0]];
144                     
145                       assign m_awid = 4'd0; assign m_awsize = 3'd4; assign m_awburst = 2'b01;
146                       assign m_awvalid = (m_st == M_AW);
147                       assign m_awaddr  = axi_base + {36'b0, c_o[27:4], 4'b0};
148                       assign m_awlen   = {1'b0, c_nw} - 8'd1;
149

151                       assign m_wvalid = wv && (m_st == M_W);
152                       assign m_wdata  = rd_data[127:0];

154                       assign rd_re    = (m_st == M_W) && (iss_left != 0) && (!wv || m_wready);

156

161        1/1              for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) begin

163                           logic [3:0] bm;

168        2/2                  else if (di == 0)        bm = c_fb;

170        1/1                  else                     bm = 4'b1111;

                        MISSING_ELSE

173                         end
174                       end
175                       assign m_wstrb = strb;
176

181                       assign busy = (m_st != M_IDLE) || (d_rp != d_wp);
182                     
183                       always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
184        1/1              if (!rst_n) begin

187                         end else begin
188                           // pend_ok : accepted writes (counted in tl_rx p_acc_cnt) whose AXI burst has not started yet. A flush drops
189                           // them, so they are added to b_cnt at once: reads ordered behind them (AX-12, nd_snap) must not wait forever.

                        MISSING_ELSE
196        1/1                  pend_ok <= pend_ok + 16'(mw_res_v && mw_res_ok) - 16'(m_st == M_IDLE && !head_skip && head_ready);
197                           end

202        1/1                    else if (head_ready) begin

208                               end
                        MISSING_ELSE
209                             end

214                             M_W: begin

                        MISSING_ELSE

                        MISSING_ELSE

257                       // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
258                       typedef struct packed {

                        MISSING_ELSE

287                       // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
288                       // delivery
289                       // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
290                       typedef enum logic [0:0] {D_IDLE, D_RUN} dstate_t;

294                       logic          rd_vld;

297                       // hold the next frame when the tail of this one is still being emitted)
298                       logic [5:0]    rd_nbf, rd_nbt;

304                       logic [5:0]    nbt;

307                       assign nbt = 6'((dcur.tbytes + 9'd15) >> 4);

312                       desc_t d_head;
313                       assign d_head = desc_mem[d_rp];
314                       // back-to-back delivery: at the last ring read of a frame, start the next accepted frame in the
315                       // same cycle (no idle cycle between frames, LK-4 / 2.4)
316                       wire run_last = (dst == D_RUN) && (ri == dcur.nbf - 6'd1);
317                       wire chain    = run_last && (desc_cnt != 0) && d_head.accept;
318                       assign d_pop  = ((dst == D_IDLE) && (desc_cnt != 0) && dl_up) || (chain && dl_up);
319                     
320                       function automatic logic [3:0] keep_of(input logic [8:0] rem);
321                         logic [8:0] dws;
322        1/1              dws = (rem + 9'd3) >> 2;
323        1/1              case (dws)
324        1/1                9'd1:    return 4'b0001;
325        1/1                9'd2:    return 4'b0011;
326        1/1                9'd3:    return 4'b0111;
327        1/1                default: return 4'b1111;
328                         endcase
329                       endfunction

                        MISSING_ELSE

385        0/1     ==>          default: dst <= D_IDLE;

180                       // ---- chunk arithmetic (TL-21 / TL-22) ----------------------------------------------
181                       wire [12:0] mps_b    = (mps_code == 3'd0) ? 13'd128 : 13'd256;
182                       wire [12:0] cur_pm   = g_cur + mps_b;

187                     `endif

195                       wire [11:0] bc_c     = g_end[11:0] - {g_cur[11:2], 2'b00};
196                     `else
197                       wire [11:0] bc_c     = g_end[11:0] - g_cur[11:0];
198                     `endif

200                       function automatic logic [4:0] lead_f(input logic [3:0] be);
201        1/1              return be[0] ? 5'd0 : be[1] ? 5'd1 : be[2] ? 5'd2 : 5'd3;
202                       endfunction
203                       function automatic logic [4:0] trail_f(input logic [3:0] be);
204        1/1              return be[3] ? 5'd0 : be[2] ? 5'd1 : be[1] ? 5'd2 : 5'd3;
205                       endfunction
206                     
207                       // A word read from the RAM reaches dw_repack one cycle later (rd_v), so that word is in flight and not yet in
208                       // e_occ / of_cnt: reserve its up-to-2 output words as well as the 2 of the word issued now (bug B-S5: with +2 only,
209                       // a long cpl0_ready stall - finite Cpl credits - overflowed the 8-entry FIFO and truncated a CplD).
210                       wire [4:0] of_need  = 5'(of_cnt) + 5'(e_occ) + (rd_v ? 5'd2 : 5'd0) + 5'd2;
211                       wire space_ok = (of_need <= 5'd8);
212                       assign rb_re  = (g_st == G_FEED) && space_ok;
213                       assign rb_ra  = {g_slot, rd_word};
214                     
215                       wire [SW-1:0] sl = g_slot;
216                       wire [12:0] sl_a    = {1'b0, s_a[sl]};
217                       wire [12:0] sl_start = sl_a + {8'b0, lead_f(s_fbe[sl])};
218                       wire [12:0] sl_end   = (s_len[sl] == 10'd1) ? (sl_a + 13'd4 - {8'b0, trail_f(s_fbe[sl])})
219                                                                   : (sl_a + {1'b0, s_len[sl], 2'b00} - {8'b0, trail_f(s_lbe[sl])});

159                       assign q_pkt = {(cpl_cnt != '0), (np_cnt != '0), (p_cnt != '0)};
160                       assign np_pending = !q_empty[1];
161                     
162                       // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
163                       // credit state (TL-10)
164                       // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
165                       logic [2:0][7:0]  lim_h;
166                       logic [2:0][11:0] lim_d;
167                       logic [2:0]       inf_h, inf_d;
168                       assign lim_h = {fc_lim_cpl_hdr, fc_lim_np_hdr, fc_lim_p_hdr};
169                       assign lim_d = {fc_lim_cpl_data, fc_lim_np_data, fc_lim_p_data};
170                       assign inf_h = {fc_inf_cpl_hdr, fc_inf_np_hdr, fc_inf_p_hdr};
171                       assign inf_d = {fc_inf_cpl_data, fc_inf_np_data, fc_inf_p_data};
172                     
173                       logic [2:0][7:0]  cc_h;
174                       logic [2:0][11:0] cc_d;
175                       logic [2:0][11:0] need_d;
176                       logic [2:0]       cr_ok, ord_ok, elig, blk_cr;
177                       logic             p_exists;
178                       logic [15:0]      p_min_age;
179                     
180                       always_comb begin
181        1/1              p_exists  = q_pkt[0] || open_valid;
182        1/1              p_min_age = q_age[0];
183        2/2              if (!q_pkt[0]) p_min_age = open_age;
184        1/2     ==>      else if (open_valid && age_lt(open_age, q_age[0])) p_min_age = open_age;
                        MISSING_ELSE
185        1/1              for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) begin
186                           logic [9:0] len;
187        1/1                len = {q_data[c][17:16], q_data[c][31:24]};
188                     `ifdef MUT_19
189                           need_d[c] = q_data[c][6] ? 12'(len >> 2) : 12'd0;     // Fmt[1] = has data
190                     `else
191        1/1                need_d[c] = q_data[c][6] ? 12'((len + 10'd3) >> 2) : 12'd0;     // Fmt[1] = has data
192                     `endif
193                     `ifdef MUT_16
194                           cr_ok[c]  = (inf_h[c] || (((9'(lim_h[c]) - (9'(cc_h[c]) + 9'd1)) & 9'h1FF) <= 9'd128)) &&
195                     `else
196        1/1                cr_ok[c]  = (inf_h[c] || cr_ok8 (lim_h[c], cc_h[c], 8'd1)) &&
197                     `endif
198                                       (inf_d[c] || cr_ok12(lim_d[c], cc_d[c], need_d[c]));
199                     `ifdef MUT_24
200                           ord_ok[c] = 1'b1;
201                     `else
202        1/1                ord_ok[c] = (c == 0) ? 1'b1 : !(p_exists && age_lt(p_min_age, q_age[c]));
203                     `endif
204        1/1                elig[c]   = q_pkt[c] && fc_valid && dl_up && cr_ok[c] && ord_ok[c];
205        1/1                blk_cr[c] = q_pkt[c] && fc_valid && dl_up && !cr_ok[c] && ord_ok[c];
206                         end
207                       end
208                     
209                       // WC-3 : an NP / Cpl TLP is queued behind the open posted TLP
210                       assign coal_flush = open_valid && ((q_pkt[1] && age_lt(open_age, q_age[1])) ||
211                                                          (q_pkt[2] && age_lt(open_age, q_age[2])));
212                     
213                       // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
214                       // arbiter (TL-9): smallest age among eligible heads
215                       // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
216                       logic [1:0] pick;
217                       logic       pick_v;
218                       always_comb begin
219        2/2              pick_v = 1'b0; pick = 2'd0;
220        1/1              for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) begin
221        1/1                if (elig[c] && (!pick_v || age_lt(q_age[c], q_age[pick]))) begin
222        2/2                  pick = 2'(c); pick_v = 1'b1;
223                           end
                        MISSING_ELSE
224                         end
225                       end
226                     
227                       logic       streaming, locked;
228                       logic [1:0] str_sel, lock_sel, cur_sel;
229                       logic       cur_v;
230                       always_comb begin
231        3/3              if (streaming)   begin cur_sel = str_sel;  cur_v = 1'b1; end
232        3/3              else if (locked) begin cur_sel = lock_sel; cur_v = 1'b1; end
233        2/2              else             begin cur_sel = pick;     cur_v = pick_v; end
234                       end
235                     
236                       assign tl_tx_valid = cur_v && dl_up;
237                       assign tl_tx_data  = q_data[cur_sel];
238                       assign tl_tx_keep  = q_keep[cur_sel];
239                       assign tl_tx_eop   = q_eopf[cur_sel];
240                       assign tl_tx_sop   = !streaming;
241                     
242                       wire acc = tl_tx_valid && tl_tx_ready;
243                       always_comb begin
244        1/1              q_pop = '0;
245        2/2              if (acc) q_pop[cur_sel] = 1'b1;
                        MISSING_ELSE
246                       end
247                     
248                       always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
249        1/1              if (!rst_n) begin
250        4/4                streaming <= 1'b0; locked <= 1'b0; str_sel <= '0; lock_sel <= '0;
251        1/1              end else if (flush) begin
252        4/4                streaming <= 1'b0; locked <= 1'b0; str_sel <= '0; lock_sel <= '0;
253                         end else begin
254        3/3                if (tl_tx_valid && !tl_tx_ready && !streaming) begin locked <= 1'b1; lock_sel <= cur_sel; end
                        MISSING_ELSE
255        1/1                if (acc) begin
256        1/1                  locked <= 1'b0;
257        3/3                  if (!streaming && !tl_tx_eop) begin streaming <= 1'b1; str_sel <= cur_sel; end
                        MISSING_ELSE
258        2/2                  if (streaming && tl_tx_eop)   streaming <= 1'b0;
                        MISSING_ELSE
259                           end
                        MISSING_ELSE
260                         end
261                       end
262                     
263                       always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
264        1/1              if (!rst_n) begin
265        2/2                cc_h <= '0; cc_d <= '0;
266        1/1              end else if (flush) begin
267        2/2                cc_h <= '0; cc_d <= '0;
268        1/1              end else if (acc && !streaming) begin
269        1/1                cc_h[cur_sel] <= cc_h[cur_sel] + 8'd1;
270        1/1                cc_d[cur_sel] <= cc_d[cur_sel] + need_d[cur_sel];
271                         end
                        MISSING_ELSE
